Whether you’re commuting to work, attending college, or traveling, this premium is built to keep your essentials organized and protected.

Made with high-quality 100% polyester fabric, the bag ensures long-lasting performance, making it perfect for daily use. Its water-resistant exterior keeps your belongings safe from accidental splashes and sudden weather changes. With features such as a bottle holder, shoe compartment, umbrella holder, lock belt, and dedicated key holder, this backpack ensures complete convenience for modern users. The added advantage of 17-inch laptop compatibility makes it a top choice for professionals, students, and travelers.

Why Choose the Jack & Jones Jeff Max Backpack Bag?

If you are searching for a durable and stylish loaded with smart storage features, the stands out among high-demand categories like laptop, travel bags, and work bags. The 25-litre capacity offers ample room for daily essentials without compromising comfort or mobility. This backpack has been engineered for users who prefer a lightweight yet sturdy accessory. The 100% polyester build enhances tear resistance, ensuring the backpack can withstand everyday wear. The dedicated shoe compartment is ideal for gym-goers and travelers, helping you keep footwear separate from clothes or electronics. The bottle holder and umbrella holder add to the practical utility, making this bag useful throughout the year.
